question.prompt: \(\angle AOB=30^\circ\), \(\angle BOC=45^\circ\), and ray OB lies in the interior of \(\angle AOC\). What is the measure of \(\angle AOC\), in degrees?

solutions.explanation: Ray OB lies in the interior of \(\angle AOC\), so \(\angle AOC=\angle AOB+\angle BOC=30^\circ+45^\circ=75^\circ\).
solutions.title: Add the component angles
